name: reforma-hub
description: Reforma Hub - marketplace pay-per-lead de oficios y reformas

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm infra:up
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8010
scripts.api:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m scripts.seed
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.dev: pnpm infra:up && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm api:dev" "pnpm web:dev"
scripts.verify:flow: cd apps/api && uv run python -m scripts.verify_purchase_flow
